title: Annotated[T, metadata] 运行时类型元数据挂载
tier1_tldr: 对静态类型检查器而言 Annotated[list, operator.add] 等价于普通 list；但第二个参数 operator.add 会原封不动保留在类的运行时类型注解对象中，供 StateGraph 编译期反射提取并组装 BinaryOperatorAggregate 归约通道。
tier1_analogy: 等价于 Go 语言的 Struct Tag（`json:"logs"`）或 TypeScript 的 reflect-metadata 属性装饰器。

tier2_slice.minimal_code:
import operator
from typing import Annotated, TypedDict, get_type_hints

class State(TypedDict):
    logs: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]

hints = get_type_hints(State, include_extras=True)
reducer = hints['logs'].__metadata__[0]
print('Extracted reducer:', reducer(['a'], ['b']))
